prompts.triage: You triage one CI log excerpt. Reply with JSON only. step: the most specific name of the failing unit, meaning a gate, check or test name if the log names one, otherwise the CI job or step name. errorLine: the single most diagnostic error line, copied verbatim from the log. class: the root-cause class. Classes: gate-failure (a policy, lint or verification gate reported a violation), test-failure (a test assertion failed), segfault (a process crashed on an invalid memory access), out-of-memory (a process was killed after exhausting memory), vm-state (a virtual machine or runner is in the wrong state), network (a host could not be resolved or reached), missing-secret (a required token or credential was not supplied), timeout (a job or step exceeded its time limit). Never invent text that is not in the log.
prompts.security: You review one code excerpt for security defects. Reply with JSON only. findings: one entry per defect, each with its class and 1-based line number. Classes: secret-on-command-line (a secret passed as a process argument), command-injection (untrusted text reaches a shell), path-traversal (untrusted text builds a file path), secret-in-log (a secret is printed or logged), tls-verification-disabled (certificate checks are turned off), unpinned-download (downloaded code runs without a pinned hash or signature). Report only defects present in the excerpt; if there are none, return an empty findings list.
prompts.tool: You dispatch a cloud agent's question to the peer machine. Call ask_peer exactly once with the one verb that answers the question. Verbs: identity (OS build and uptime), vbox (virtual machine states), disk (free disk space), ollama (Ollama version and loaded models), lbabus (installed lbabus version).
